name: Discovery Program (Summer Health Sciences)
what_you_do: This is a two-week summer program on the Loma Linda campus. It is for high school students interested in health sciences careers.
who_can_apply: High school students in 9th through 12th grade in the Inland Empire who are interested in health sciences. Students 17 and a half or older may be invited to an optional shadowing week.
pay_detail: $30 non-refundable application fee (fee waiver available for financial need). The page does not list a program cost.
duration: 2 weeks (2026: July 12 to July 24), plus optional shadowing week
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Jan 12 to April 12, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; expect a similar January to April window.
how_to_apply: Submit the application form, a recommendation form from a teacher or clergy member, a 200-word essay on your interest in health sciences, and the $30 fee or a waiver request.
notes: Closed until the next cycle opens. Loma Linda University is a Seventh-day Adventist institution.
